MISSION CARRIER KILLER
SITUATION OPAREA: Northwest Pacific. An Oscar I and Victor III screen are approaching a carrier launch line.
MISSION Destroy the screen command and withdraw.
EXECUTION Penetrate the escort screen, destroy the screen command, and break contact before carrier support arrives.
RULES OF ENGAGEMENT Weapons release is authorized against the screen command. Conserve torpedoes for follow-on operations.
FRIENDLY FORCES USS Los Angeles is the flagship and must survive. USS Drum is assigned; its loss does not end the operation.
SUPPORT No surface or air unit is under player control. Manage weapons and damage for the next patrol.
